overview: Rise 5.99's LongJump is a ten-mode horizontal boost module (the Hycraft branch is dead: referenced in onEnable and onPacketReceive but never registered in the mode list) whose common shape is damage or a staged jump to get airborne, then a horizontal pin per air phase. NCP Normal re-jumps every grounded tick with motionY 0.424 minus jitter and strafes at 0.4 grounded and 1.4 on the first air tick; NCP Damage waits for self-inflicted hurtTime from a bow or throwable, then runs the classic decay model (grounded reset to 0.2873 * 2.15, air increment of 0.15 times the excess, then lastDist minus lastDist over 159.998) with a staged 0.424/0.42/0.045 vertical; Cubecraft self-damages through DamageUtil POSITION damage then boosts to a 0.6 jump and 0.4 strafe; the Minemenclub pair sinks the ground position 2.5 blocks until hurt arrives, then jumps with motionY 0.6 and strafes base plus 1 (0.32 for the Safe variant); Vulcan fires 36 C04s in one tick, six repeats of a six-rung 0.42-to-0.003 gravity ladder, plus a grounded C03 to fake the fall damage, then boosts motionY 0.6 and strafes 9.5; Taka floods 16 C04s on enable at a 0.2 timer then strafes 9.85; Hypixel stalls 33 ticks at a 5.25 timer with movement suppressed and a posY desync, then double-jumps with 0.76 and strafes at 1.6 to 1.7 times base speed.

sections.p: The logic splits across five handlers plus enable and disable. onEnable resets the state machine, refuses to arm in air for Hycraft and Vulcan, and for Taka drops the timer to 0.2 and floods 16 C04s (eight repeats of a +0.42/back-to-y pair, onGround false). onMove handles only NCP Damage. onPreMotion holds every other mode: it counts ticks and offGroundTicks, tracks lastDist from the per-tick delta, drives the autoDisable re-ground toggle, and dispatches the mode switch. onStrafe cancels the strafe event until the jump condition holds (damage for NCP Damage, Minemenclub and Vulcan). onPacketSend for Vulcan cancels every C03 until damage arrives and buffers C0F and C00 packets; onPacketReceive cancels S12 velocity and S27 explosion for Hycraft and Vulcan. onMoveButton suppresses movement input during the Hypixel stall. onDisable restores speedInAir, jumpMovementFactor, the timer, and the camera offset.

NCP Damage scans the hotbar for a bow with arrows, or a fishing rod, snowball or egg, switches to it, and fires C08 placements (a C07 RELEASE_USE_ITEM at tick 11 plus a random 1-2) to hurt the player; until hurtTime turns positive it forces pitch to minus 89 to 90 and cancels strafing. Once hurt, the decay model runs: on ground moveSpeed resets to max(0.2873 * 2.15, current) with the reset flag set, the next air tick adds 0.15 times the excess over base, and subsequent ticks decay via lastDist minus lastDist over 159.998, with the stage counter applying 0.424 minus jitter, then 0.42, then four empty stages, plus a 0.045 glide. Cubecraft instead self-damages through DamageUtil.damagePlayer with the POSITION type at 0.0465, jumps with motionY 0.6 plus jitter, strafes 0.4, then 0.6 on the first air tick, and adds 0.0425 to motionY while fallDistance is under 3. The Minemenclub pair holds the ground y down 2.5 blocks (event.setY minus 2.5 plus jitter) until a hit registers, then jumps with motionY 0.6 and pins the strafe to base plus 1.0 (Minemenclub) or base plus 0.32 (Safe).

Vulcan's onPreMotion, at ticks 5 on the ground, sends 36 C04s: six repeats of the six-rung gravity ladder 0.42, 0.33319999363422365, 0.24813599859094576, 0.16477328182606651, 0.08307781780646721, 0.0030162615090425808, each onGround false, then a grounded C03(true) and a ground claim on the event, so the server tallies a long fall and applies damage; once hurtTime arrives, motionY is set to 0.6 (1.5 over a bed) and the strafe pins 9.5, then 0.5 on the first air tick. Taka runs at the 0.2 timer and strafes 9.85 for 13 ticks, restarting the window on each hurtTime 9 and re-boosting motionY to 0.42. Hypixel spends 33 ticks (11 * 3) at timer 5.25 with onMoveButton suppressing all input, the camera locked, and posY stepped back toward lastTickPosY each tick while the event claims off-ground; after the stall, the timer drops to the Hypixel Timer setting, grounded ticks re-boost motionY to 0.76 minus jitter, the first air tick strafes at 1.6 times base (1.7 with speed potion), later air ticks hold 1.07 or 1.02, and air ticks under offGroundTicks 5 strafe at 1.29 times current speed, with a 0.027 air boost while falling.

files.label: LongJump.java (module)
files.explanation: This 659-line file is the entire module. The handler split is what makes it readable: onMove carries only the NCP Damage decay model, onPreMotion carries the other nine modes plus the tick and offGroundTicks bookkeeping and the autoDisable toggle, onPacketSend implements the Vulcan C03 cancellation and the C0F/C00 buffer, onPacketReceive cancels S12 and S27 velocity packets, onStrafe gates the strafe event behind each mode's damage condition, and onMoveButton implements the Hypixel input stall. The dead Hycraft branch lives in onEnable and onPacketReceive, which test mode.is("Hycraft") that no registered mode can satisfy.

files.label: DamageUtil.java (self-damage helper)
files.explanation: damagePlayer with the POSITION damage type is the Cubecraft mode's self-hurt mechanism: it drives the player into a controlled fall-damage application (here 0.0465 with the fallback and ignore-flag arguments false and true) so the module gets the hurtTime window it needs before boosting. NCP Damage does not use this helper; it builds its own bow and throwable C08/C07 sequence. The file documents the alternative damage path and is the module's only damage-side dependency.

countering.label: SurvivalFly (horizontal and vertical envelope)
countering.explanation: SurvivalFly measures every move against a physics model: the horizontal allowance comes from prepareSpeedEstimation (predicted per-tick sprint distance, 0.91 air inertia, sprint +30%) and the vertical from vDistRel, seeded from the previous move's momentum and gated to named envelopes (zero-y ground moves, jumps, step-ups, riptide). NCP Normal's first air tick at 1.4 blocks per tick against a ~0.31 prediction gives hDistanceAboveLimit around 1.09 and a violation near 109; the decay-model modes (NCP Damage at 0.6177 grounded, Minemenclub at base plus 1) sit far above the prediction for their entire arcs. Hypixel's 0.76 double-jump is the vertical tell: a 0.76 rise is not a jump envelope (isJumpMotion covers the vanilla 0.42 class), so yDistanceAboveLimit lands near 0.34 on top of the horizontal excess. Vulcan's ladder C04s are measured per packet: each rung is an onGround-false rise with no registered jump, so each contributes yDistanceAboveLimit to the violation even though the server-side fall damage is what the module is buying. The set-back snaps the player to the stored location on every violation.

countering.label: MorePackets (movement packet rate)
countering.explanation: MorePackets counts every serverbound move packet into 500ms buckets against a 22/s window (20 ideal) with a half-second burst path (15 packets, 10 direct-violation). Vulcan is the clearest hit: 36 C04s plus the grounded C03 in one tick is 37 packets against a 15-packet half-second burst ceiling, an immediate direct violation regardless of what the window average looks like afterward. Taka's on-enable flood of 16 C04s in one tick clears the same burst ceiling on its own, and its 0.2 timer afterwards only lowers the sustained rate, it does not erase the burst. The other modes send one C03 per tick and stay under the rate checks, so for them the envelope is the relevant counter. The Vulcan and Taka floods also arrive before the damage mechanic matters, so the check fires at the enable tick, not after the boost.

countering.label: Speed (stage table and ground expectation)
countering.explanation: Arc v2's Speed check compares reported horizontal speed against per-stage expectations: base 0.2873 with 0.049 added at zero vertical, 0.08 while descending under 0.34, 0.3261 while rising at or above 0.34, and on the ground thisMove over groundTime plus baseMove once groundTicks reach 5. NCP Damage's decay curve is the classic profile this table was built for: the 0.6177 grounded re-reset against the 0.3498 ground expectation flags as soon as groundTicks hits 5, and the air speeds above the descending-stage 0.3673 flag every descending tick with the BunnyHop label. Hypixel's 1.6 to 1.7 times base (0.4597 to 0.4884) passes the rising stage cap of 0.6134 only while ascending and fails the descending stage immediately; Minemenclub's base plus 1 (1.2873) and Vulcan's 9.5 are orders past every stage and flag on the first air tick. Set-back snaps the player to the last accepted `from` position.

countering.label: Speed (momentum conservation)
countering.explanation: Hawk's Speed check predicts the next move from the previous one: expected speed is friction times lastSpeed (0.91 air, block slipperiness on ground) plus a small adder set (the vanilla sprint-jump +0.2, hit slowdown, soul sand, web), and the discrepancy accumulates until it crosses the 0.1 threshold, then punishAndTryRubberband with the VL scaled by the discrepancy. Every pinned strafe in this module exceeds the momentum model on the first move: Vulcan's 9.5 and Taka's 9.85 produce discrepancies in the tens, Minemenclub's base plus 1 is several times the threshold, and even NCP Normal's 1.4 first air tick against a friction-decayed previous speed near 0.28 gives a discrepancy over 1.0, ten times the flag threshold. The jump adder forgives only the vanilla 0.2 sprint-jump boost, so none of the module's boosts can be absorbed by the model. The rubber-band snaps the player back to Hawk's estimated position, which also kills the momentum the module needs.
